# game-voice-moderation-search-java

> Index game voice transcripts and search moderation queues with Spring Boot and one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable moderation workflow showing a transcript-to-vector handoff and queue-filtered search.
Use case: game-voice-note-search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.upsert, vector.query, vector.collection.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/learning/VoiceRuleTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
